items.a: No. You can order from just 1 piece. Tiered pricing is available for larger quantities through Bulk Order.

items.q: Which design file formats are accepted?
items.a: We accept PNG and SVG files. Use the highest resolution possible with a transparent background for sharp prints.
Production starts once payment is confirmed and an admin approves your order. You can follow the status anytime on your My Orders page.
Payments are processed through Midtrans, so options such as bank transfer/virtual account, e-wallets, and cards are available.
Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after 24 hours. You can place a new order at any time.
Courier options and shipping costs are shown at checkout once you select a delivery address.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Once your order ships, the tracking number appears on your order detail page and you receive a notification.

items.q: What if the product I received is damaged or wrong?
items.a: Submit a claim following our Returns & Refund Policy, with photos or video of what you received, then reach us through the Contact page.

items.q: How do I become a creator?
items.a: Sign up, then apply as a creator from your account page. Once approved, you can upload designs to sell on the marketplace and earn commission on each sale.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Reach our team directly for further help.

sections.title: 1. Products Are Made to Order
sections.body: Every product is custom printed from the customer's design and size/color choices. Orders therefore cannot be returned or exchanged because of a change of mind, a wrongly chosen size, or screen color differences.

sections.title: 2. Eligible Claims
sections.body: You may file a claim if the product has a production defect (for example the print does not match the design file or the material is faulty), the product received does not match the order, or the product was damaged during shipping.

sections.title: 3. How to File a Claim
sections.body: Contact us through the Contact page within 3 days of receiving your order. Include your order number and clear photos or video showing the product and its packaging.

sections.title: 4. Resolution
sections.body: Once the claim is verified, we will offer a reprint or a refund depending on the case. Refunds are sent back to the payment method you used.

sections.title: 5. Order Cancellation
sections.body: Orders can be cancelled while awaiting approval. Once production begins, an order can no longer be cancelled. Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after 24 hours.

sections.title: 1. Couriers
sections.body: Orders are shipped through logistics partners. Available couriers are shown at checkout based on your destination.

sections.title: 2. Shipping Cost
sections.body: Shipping cost is calculated automatically from the destination, order weight, and the courier you choose, and is added to your total.

sections.title: 3. Processing & Delivery Time
sections.body: Orders are produced after payment is confirmed and approved by an admin. Transit time follows the chosen courier service and varies by region.

sections.title: 4. Tracking
sections.body: A tracking number is available on your order detail page once the parcel is handed to the courier.

sections.title: 5. Receiving Your Order
sections.body: Please inspect the parcel on arrival. If the packaging is damaged, document it with photos or video before opening. An order is automatically marked complete 3 business days after arrival if not confirmed.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using the Harmoni Clothing platform.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: Harmoni Clothing's privacy policy: the data we collect and how we use it.

dataCollected.title: 1. Data We Collect
dataCollected.p1: We collect data you provide directly when registering for and using Harmoni Clothing's services, including: name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment data processed through our payment gateway partner.
dataCollected.p2: For Creators, we also collect identity verification data (ID card and selfie) required for the KYC (Know Your Customer) process before a Creator account is activated.

dataUsage.title: 2. Use of Data
dataUsage.body: The data we collect is used to process orders, communicate about order status, verify Creator accounts, disburse commissions, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

dataSharing.title: 3. Sharing Data with Third Parties
dataSharing.body: Shipping data is shared with logistics partners for product delivery purposes. Payment data is processed through a verified payment gateway (Midtrans) according to industry security standards; we do not store your payment card details.

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.body: We apply encryption, session-based authentication, and internal access restrictions to protect your personal data from unauthorized access.

userRights.title: 5. Your Rights
userRights.body: You have the right to access, update, or request deletion of your personal data by contacting our support team through the Help Center.

policyChanges.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-platform notification.

definitions.title: 1. Definitions
definitions.body: "Harmoni Clothing" is a print-on-demand platform and design marketplace operated to connect Customers, Creators, and garment production services.

userAccount.title: 2. User Accounts
userAccount.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential. Harmoni reserves the right to suspend accounts showing signs of violations or suspicious activity.

ordersPayment.title: 3. Orders & Payment
ordersPayment.body: Orders are considered valid once payment is verified through our payment gateway. Displayed prices already include the designer contribution for products from the Design Marketplace, but exclude shipping costs.

creatorRights.title: 4. Creator Rights & Obligations
creatorRights.body: Creators warrant that uploaded designs are original work or that they hold full rights to distribute them. Harmoni reserves the right to reject or take down designs that infringe copyright or violate content policy.

cancellationRefund.title: 5. Cancellation & Refunds
cancellationRefund.body: Orders can be cancelled while still pending approval. Once production has begun, cancellation follows the applicable return policy based on the product's condition.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Harmoni is not responsible for delays caused by third parties (logistics partners) outside our control.

termsChanges.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
termsChanges.body: These terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
